ACGL.thesis: A disciplined, lowly levered specialty insurer earning high-teens ROE trades below peers and low in its own EV/EBITDA range while in a healthy uptrend, with buybacks compounding per-share value through a softening cycle.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 12%, showing the soft cycle is eroding returns beyond a normal cyclical dip.
TTM ROE falls below 14%, well under the 18.7% now, signalling underwriting returns have broken down.
Net debt/EBITDA rises above 1.5x, reversing the deleveraging.
Insurance or reinsurance underwriting income turns negative in two consecutive 10-Qs (sec.gov).

BUD:RICHTER.thesis: A net-cash pharma with rising returns and margins trades low in its own EV/EBITDA and P/FCF ranges while in a healthy uptrend.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below 28%, reversing most of the rise from 28.7% a year earlier to 34.5%.
TTM ROIC falls below 16%, back to the FY2021 level and erasing the returns improvement.
TTM FCF margin falls below 18%, showing the rolling slide from 29.3% is structural, not timing.
Net debt/EBITDA (ratios page) rises above 1.0x from -0.61x, signalling a debt-funded deal.

CI.thesis: A deleveraging PBM and employer-health franchise with ROIC of 12.6% and an 11.58% FCF yield trades below its own 5-year minimum P/E and EV/EBITDA, where the price implies a revenue decline that raised 2026 guidance does not show.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 10%, giving up most of the five-year improvement from 8.8% to 12.6%.
TTM operating margin falls below 3.5%, under the FY2025 five-year low of 3.7%, showing rebate reform or medical cost pressure is compressing profitability structurally.
TTM FCF margin falls below 2.0%, well under the current 2.9%, signalling cash generation and buyback capacity are deteriorating.
Net debt/EBITDA rises above 2.5x (1.87x TTM now), reversing the deleveraging.

DECK.thesis: A net-cash, very high-return footwear brand owner with flat margins and ROCE at its 2-year high trades below its own 5-year minimum P/E, EV/EBITDA and P/FCF at a 10.12% FCF yield, pricing a revenue decline its slowed-but-positive outlook does not show.

triggers.text: TTM gross margin falls below 55%, under the FY2024 level of 55.6%, showing rival discounting or markdowns are eroding full-price discipline.
TTM operating margin falls below 20%, reversing most of the five-year expansion from 18.0%.
TTM FCF margin falls below 14%, showing working capital or margin stress rather than a seasonal swing.
TTM ROIC falls below 55%, showing the decline from 72.7% is no longer capital build but eroding returns.

GDDY.thesis: A deleveraging, high-return domain and SMB-software franchise with a 33.7% FCF margin trades below its own 5-year minimum EV/EBITDA and P/FCF, where the price implies a revenue decline that growing bookings and high-end guidance do not show.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 20%, reversing most of the five-year improvement from 12.5% (FY2021) to 28.7%.
TTM operating margin falls below 20%, erasing the post-2023 step-up (FY2024 20.4%).
TTM FCF margin falls below 25%, under the FY2024 level of 27.6%, showing the cash gains were transitory.
Total bookings growth in the 10-Q/earnings release turns negative for two consecutive quarters (AI substitution showing in demand), or net debt/EBITDA on the ratios page rises above 3.0x.

HKG:3998.thesis: China's leading down-jacket brand, net cash with ROIC of 68.7% and an 11.97% FCF yield, trades below its own 5-year minimum EV/EBITDA and EV/Sales, where the price implies a -12.8% revenue decline its stable margins and recovering cash flow do not show.

triggers.text: TTM gross margin falls below 55%, under the five-year low of 57.2%, signalling loss of brand pricing power.
TTM net margin falls below 10%, reversing the five-year rise to 14.6% and indicating the brand premium has eroded.
TTM ROIC falls below 40%, a reversion toward FY2022 levels that undercuts the moat thesis.
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2025 five-year low of 12.2%, signalling inventory or working-capital stress from a demand down-cycle.

HKG:9999.thesis: A net-cash games franchise with operating margin rising to 35.2% and a 43.5% FCF margin trades below its own 5-year minimum EV/EBITDA and P/FCF, where the price implies a revenue decline its improving fundamentals do not show.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below the FY2024 level of 28.1%, reversing the five-year expansion.
TTM FCF margin falls below the FY2024 level of 36.5%, signalling cash generation is no longer keeping pace.
TTM gross margin falls below the FY2024 level of 62.5%, indicating game-portfolio mix or monetization is deteriorating.
A new PRC regulation materially restricts game monetization, or a VIE-related regulatory action forces deconsolidation, as disclosed in a company filing or release.

INTU.thesis: A low-debt financial-software franchise with ROIC, operating and FCF margins at their 2-year highs trades below its own 5-year minimum multiples at a 12.68% FCF yield, pricing a revenue decline its results do not show.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 16%, giving up most of the rise from 18.7% a year earlier to 22.7%.
TTM FCF margin falls below 30%, back near the FY2024 level of 28.8%, meaning the cash step-up was transitory.
TTM gross margin falls below 78%, under the FY2023 five-year low of 79.3%, signalling free or AI-native rivals are forcing price cuts.
Consumer segment revenue (10-Q) declines year on year for two consecutive reported periods, showing free filing and AI eroding the TurboTax base.

JKHY.thesis: A high-return, unlevered core-banking franchise with recovering rolling returns and raised guidance trades below its own 5-year median multiples, but its price already implies growth above the company's framework.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 19%, the FY2024 trough, evidencing moat erosion.
TTM operating margin falls below 22%, under the FY2024 low of 22.1%, showing cloud/AI/security investment or renewal pricing is compressing profitability structurally.
TTM FCF margin falls below 20%, reversing the rising trend (TTM 27.6%).
Organic revenue growth (10-Q MD&A, ex-deconversion) turns negative, processing revenue growth falls below 5% for two consecutive quarters, or core client losses outnumber wins.

LDOS.thesis: A government-IT incumbent with ROIC well above its FY2021-23 levels and an 11.0% FCF margin trades below its own 5-year minimum on every earnings multiple and below peers, where the price implies a revenue decline that raised EPS guidance does not show.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below 10.5%, reversing most of the five-year expansion from 8.5% to 11.8%.
TTM ROIC falls below 13%, showing the decline from 16.6% is no longer an acquisition denominator effect.
TTM FCF margin falls below 8%, back to the level of a year earlier.
Net debt/EBITDA on the ratios page rises above 3.0x (2.46x TTM now) without a visible deleveraging path from the Entrust debt.

RELY.thesis: A net-cash, newly profitable digital remitter with rising margins and a 9.30% FCF yield trades at the bottom of its own P/FCF range, pricing a fade its raised guidance does not show.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below 8%, reversing most of the step-up from 2.2% a year earlier to 13.0%.
TTM ROIC falls below 20%, showing the returns step-up was not durable.
TTM FCF margin falls below 12%, back near the 11.1% of a year earlier.
A regulatory outcome (AUSTRAC or US remittance rules) restricts a major corridor or imposes a material penalty, disclosed in a filing.

SHA:603939.thesis: A net-cash Chinese pharmacy chain with rising ROIC trades low in its own P/E range and below its 5-year minimum EV/EBITDA while in a healthy uptrend, though peers are cheaper on cash multiples and regulation caps margins.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 15%, giving up most of the rise from 14.0% in FY2021 to 24.9%.
TTM operating margin falls below 8.5%, under the five-year low of 8.9%.
TTM gross margin falls below 36%, showing drug-pricing or reimbursement pressure.
TTM FCF margin falls below 8%, under the FY2021 level of 8.6%.

TYO:2875.thesis: A net-cash, high-ROIC Japanese noodle and food maker with rising rolling margins trades below its own 5-year minimum P/E and P/FCF and well below peers, pricing no growth.

triggers.text: TTM ROIC falls below 18%, giving up most of the rise from 11.4% in FY2022 to 24.4%.
TTM operating margin falls below 13%, back under the FY2024 level of 13.6%, showing the margin gains were input-cost relief.
TTM gross margin falls below 28%, under the FY2024 level of 28.7%, signalling lost pricing power.
TTM FCF margin falls below 6%, back to the level of a year earlier, showing the cash recovery was transitory.

ZTS.thesis: A high-return animal-health franchise with intact margins trades below its own 5-year minimum multiples, pricing near-stagnation, but companion-animal competition keeps the upside uncertain.

triggers.text: TTM operating margin falls below the FY2023 5-year low of 35.9%, showing competition is eroding profitability, not just growth.
TTM gross margin falls below the FY2022 5-year low of 69.7%, signalling structural loss of pricing power.
TTM ROIC falls below 22%, a clear break below the five-year range, showing the moat's returns are eroding.
Companion-animal revenue declines operationally for two further consecutive quarters with dermatology cited in the 10-Q MD&A, or 2027 guidance implies a total revenue decline.
